title: Forecasting-enabled billing & latency anomaly explainer
creator: Jordan Kim
description: Build a forecasting-first anomaly detection pipeline that detects and explains unexpected billing, usage, and latency deviations at the customer and route level. Unlike simple threshold or single-metric spikes, this system will produce short-term forecasts and surface deviations from predicted values with causal signal enrichment and a human-readable explanation for Console alerts and PagerDuty incidents. Objectives: reduce ops false positives by 30%, surface likely root causes (routing, model variant, region, KV cache miss rates), and provide actionable links (billing ledger, recent deployments, traces).
comments: 2026-02-20 — Kickoff: aligned on scope with PM and SRE. Focus on billing spikes that are not explained by scheduled jobs or planned rollouts. Owner: Priya.

2026-02-25 — Prototype: implemented per-customer seasonal decomposition + ETS forecasts using Prophet to get baseline and confidence intervals. Early results: good fit for monthly recurring patterns, poor for sudden onboarding bursts.

2026-03-02 — Trade-off discussion: ML forecasting vs adaptive thresholds. Decision: hybrid pipeline — forecasting for baseline + lightweight rule engine for known operational events (deployments, capacity switches).

2026-03-05 — Data plan: pull token-level counters, route/model tags, region, quota changes, and recent rollout logs. Streaming ingestion via Kafka topic telemetry. Retrospective window: 12 months where available.

2026-03-08 — Explainability: will compute feature importances on residuals (LightGBM) and generate top-3 contributing signals (e.g., model-id, route,path,region). Map attributions to Console explainer UI with a short sentence template.

2026-03-10 — Integration: alerting will generate graded incidents: WARNING (soft deviation, >95% CI), ACTION (large deviation + cost impact), PAGED (sustained deviation >24h or high-dollar exposure). Wire to existing alert routing (ENG-48321) and include direct links to billing dashboard and traces.
2026-03-11 — PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1482 — contains streaming scorer and unit tests for seasonal baselines. Requesting review from @sre-team and @data-platform.
2026-03-12 — Blocker: need SRE sign-off on retention and index strategy for per-customer state in Redis; evaluating compact sketch vs full window. Follow-up: schedule SRE sync 2026-03-15.
Next steps: finish LightGBM residual model, build canary for 50 customers, run backtest on last 12 months and measure precision@alert and FPR, finalize Console UI copy for explainers.
